source.citation: Y. Wu, Y. Zhou, G. Saveriades, S. Agaian, J. P. Noonan, P. Natarajan, Local Shannon entropy measure with statistical tests for image randomness, Information Sciences 222 (2013) 323–342
source.transcription_check: All 26 rows compared with extracted full text and visually inspected on source page 334.

precision.method: Complete marginal and bivariate multinomial finite sums; no tail truncation
precision.independent_method: Condition on the combined count of two symbols, then use its binomial split

assumptions: k independent blocks with T scalar entries each
The q=256 RGB interpretation uses 8-bit scalar channel entries, not a 24-bit alphabet or T RGB triples
Binary T=2 block entropy is Bernoulli(1/2)
Endpoints define a closed acceptance interval

interpretation.binary_sizes: Exact rational binomial sums, with decimal rendering
interpretation.binary_exact_intervals: Narrowest symmetric nonrandomized acceptance interval with size no greater than alpha
interpretation.binary_exact_interval_implementation: Use inclusive integer accepted_count_min and accepted_count_max; decimal entropy endpoints are display values
interpretation.ideal_normal_source_scale_rejection_prob: Normal-law diagnostic erfc(z/sqrt(2k)); not an exact finite-k size
